## Checklist Before Merging into `main`

- [ ] Run the build after the latest changes and confirm the latest `dist/bundle.js` and `index.css` files are generated.
- [ ] Add the respective HTML, CSS, and script to the `templates` MongoDB collection for the corresponding template.
- [ ] Confirm the template preview is visible on the Personalization Dashboard.
- [ ] Confirm the template works as intended on the development store.
- [ ] Update the template data in the production MongoDB database.
